# Symbol Replacement

<!-- Generated by generate-swiftui-skill.py; edit the library sources. -->

Category: Feedback

Swap the same two SF Symbols with identical sizing and accessibility labels, changing only whether the native Replace content transition is applied.

- Before: Symbols swap instantly
- After: Symbols animate with Replace

APIs: `contentTransition`, `symbolEffect(.replace)`

## Complete improved example

Adapt the behavior to the app; demonstration controls and values are illustrative.

```swift
import SwiftUI

// iOS 17+. Present SymbolsDoExample() in your app.
struct SymbolsDoExample: View {
    @State private var phase = 0
    @State private var resetID = 0

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            SymbolsDoContent(phase: phase)
                .frame(maxWidth: 320, minHeight: 180)
                .id(resetID)
            Button("Run example") { phase += 1 }

            Button("Reset") { phase = 0; resetID += 1 }
        }
        .padding()
    }
}

struct SymbolsDoContent: View {
    var font: Font = .largeTitle
    let phase: Int
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        // excerpt:start
        Image(systemName: phase.isMultiple(of: 2) ? "arrow.down.circle" : "checkmark.circle")
            .font(font)
            .contentTransition(reduceMotion ? .identity : .symbolEffect(.replace))
            .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .default, value: phase)
            .accessibilityLabel(phase.isMultiple(of: 2) ? "Ready to download" : "Downloaded")
        // excerpt:end
    }

}
```
